google_drive.reason: The connector rejected the external write until the user gives explicit upload approval.
post_upload_checks: Read back the native Google Doc title, headings, lists, tables, architecture figure, and approval language.
Confirm no title-rule residue or placeholder text survived conversion.
Export to PDF and inspect every rendered page when the connector supports page-image handoff.
Record the Google Doc id in this manifest without making Drive the canonical transaction store.

ai_wisebase.reason: No external knowledge-base write was attempted after the Drive approval gate rejected the upload.
retrieval_tests: What is the canonical source of current job-pipeline state?
Which actions require David's explicit approval?
Which resume family maps to a remote SaaS support role?
When may a previously surfaced company return to the main shortlist?
What blocks reactivating a recurring job-search automation?
privacy_filter: Do not ingest phone numbers, full addresses, credentials, raw private email bodies, or mailbox attachments.
Keep State Not Fate framed as portfolio proof rather than formal employment or clinical qualification.
Preserve confirmed, snapshot, inferred, and unavailable source labels.

completion_rule: The external handoff is complete only after explicit approval, native Drive readback, Wisebase ingestion confirmation, and successful retrieval tests.
